label: def:skewed-poisson-structure
title: Skewed-Poisson structure
html:
A skewed-Poisson structure on a commutative formal group H is a biderivation \pi_< \colon \mathcal{O}(H) \otimes \mathcal{O}(H) \to \mathcal{O}(H) satisfying:

  1. Graded anti-symmetry: \pi_<(f, g) = -\pi_<(g, f).
  2. p-truncated Jacobi condition: \pi_<(f, \pi_<(g, h)) + \pi_<(g, \pi_<(h, f)) + \pi_<(h, \pi_<(f, g)) = 0 modulo p-th powers.

This is the infinitesimal datum encoding the non-commutativity to be "integrated" into a non-commutative formal group.

Reference: [fred2005], Definition 2.3.
